    m=np.array(inp); H,W=m.shape
    if bg is None: bg=m.flat[0]
    dots=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if m[r,c]!=bg]

    def next_cell(r,c,dr,dc):
        r+=dr; c+=dc
        if 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W: return dr,dc
        # bounce
        return (-dr,dc) if dc else (dr,-dc)
    for (sr,scc) in dots:
        colors={m[sr,scc]}
        r,scl=sr,sclc=scc; drc,dcc=1,0   # down first
        # try all 4 start dirs
        for dr0,dc0 in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
            r,c=src:=None
        pass
    return m,out

import numpy as np
def objs(g,bg):
    m=np.array(g); ma=(m!=bg)
    from scipy.ndimage import label
    L,n=label(ma)
    o=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        idx=np.where(L==i)
        ps=list(zip(idx[0],idx[1]))
        sc=m[ps]
        s=set(sc.tolist())
        # bounding box normalized offsets
        rs=[p[0] for p in ps]; cs=[p[1] for p in ps]
        h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
        pat=[tuple(sorted((r-min(rs),c-min(cs))) for r,c in ps)]
        o.append(dict(size=len(ps),shape=(h,w),pattern=pat,scores=dict(set(sc))))
    return o
